Corroborated at the NETWORK level only: MEED and Saudipedia (two independent, verified sources) confirm these are Saudi Aramco-owned/operated gas pipelines in the Hawiyah/Haradh gas-gathering network in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province (Khuff/sweet gas, part of the Master Gas System). No independent source corroborates this segment's length (56.00 km). The only GEM citation is the OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin, which contains country-level aggregate statistics and does NOT list individual pipeline segments, names, lengths, or diameters (ASB2012 resolves but has no segment data; ASB2017 link verifies 200 but contains no 'pipeline' segment tables). The only places these km-marker-named segments and their specific dimensions appear are gem.wiki and offshore-technology.com data-insights pages (GlobalData/GEM-derived, not independent). MEED documents the related Hawiyah programme with DIFFERENT figures (48"/25 km HDUG-1, 56"/1 km HUG-1, 30"/170 km, 24"/57 km, etc.), which do not match the GEM segment values here. Cannot reach 2 independent sources without fabricating a URL.

VALIDITY FLAG: this entity is a highly granular internal route-database segment named by kilometer markers / trunk-line abbreviations (e.g. 'UBTG-1-km0...', 'Hawiyah-UBTG-1-km0', 'Waqr Khuff-Haradh', 'Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah'). The underlying Saudi Aramco Hawiyah/Haradh gas-gathering network DOES exist and is operating (corroborated by MEED + Saudipedia). However, this specific named segment with its stated length/diameter is documented only by GEM and GEM/GlobalData-derived aggregators (offshore-technology data-insights) - no independent source. The sole GEM citation (OPEC ASB) is country-level aggregate data and cannot support any segment-level attribute. Real-world Aramco line names for this corridor are HUG-1 (56" Hawiyah-Uthmaniyah) and HDUG-1 (48" Haradh-Uthmaniyah) per MEED, with segment lengths (1 km, 25 km) that do not match the GEM values here. Recommend human review of whether these km-marker segments are correctly individuated and whether their length/diameter values are supportable; do not treat as verified. No silent fix applied.
